cold_definition: sealed cache cleared; default newest-first all-field warm-up awaited before each first query; OS and document cache lifecycle uncontrolled
caveats: Native Windows x64, not Pi; 5 vessels x 90 days, not 1 vessel x 1 year
One cold-after-warm observation per query, not a cold p95 distribution
Server startup does not await warm-up; requests arriving before completion can remain cold
Retained cache is byte-bounded; one field decoder's temporary allocations are additional
Historical queries need not hit newest-first warm-up; no benchmark-specific fields selected
Warm-only RSS covers the benchmark engine/cache process, not a complete server or Pi RSS

warmup_memory.rss_definition: Windows peak working set includes engine startup; warm-phase peak sampled every 50 ms

queries.description: Point lookup: true wind speed @max at a single 10s bucket
Point lookup: speed over ground @last at a bucket
Point lookup: lat/lon (geo) at a bucket
4 conjuncts: port started, SOG in range, wind speed >, depth < (set=, bsi BETWEEN, bsi >, bsi <)
set IN + bsi > + bsi < + IS NOT NULL (presence) + NOT
col-vs-col comparison (unsupported pushdown): apparent vs true wind ratio [narrowed to 05-07 00:00–06:00 UTC to keep the golden output small]
Count buckets where SOG > 6 kn and engine (main) not running (spec example)
Count buckets where battery voltage < 25 and solar > 100
Count buckets where wind speed > 25 kn (12.86 m/s)
Max wind per day over the 90-day correctness window (date_bin GROUP BY)
Mean battery voltage per hour (Q8-adjacent window aggregate; date_trunc)
Daily solar sum (sum aggregate over a day window)
Motoring in >25kn wind, runs >=5 min, max_gap 1m (spec 07 intervals example)
PV-1 energy query: electric-only motoring (motors pulling, diesel not running via IS DISTINCT FROM) >=40s
within 5 nm of a point AND depth < 3 m (spec example) [narrowed to 05-07 00:00–06:00 UTC to keep the golden output small]
in_bbox region AND SOG > 6 kn [narrowed to 05-07 00:00–06:00 UTC to keep the golden output small]
in_bbox with count (geo + count aggregate)
Mean battery voltage per hour (spec Q8 example, broad)
Mean SOG per day (broad)
Broad: mean house current per day
match(notes,'leak') AND heel/roll > 0.05 rad
match(notes,'leak OR water') AND depth < 3
match(logbook,'anchorage') AND wind > 15 kn
match(alerts,'alarm') AND SOG > 0 (docs joined to telemetry, doc score)
match(notes,'weather') AND pressure < 101000 Pa
match(notes,'bilge') AND bilge pump cycles > 0 (text + count)
